none: PAS PUBLIC-664716: PUBLIC-664716: Roman coin of Tetricus I

A copper-alloy Roman Radiate of the Gallo-Roman Emperor Tetricus I (AD270-273; Reece Period 13). Reverse Type: Laetitia holding a wreath, left, and an anchor, right, with the inscription LAETIT I. AUGG; Obverse Type: A Radiate crowned emperor, Tetricus I, facing right, with a full beard; Weight: 2.13 grammes; Diameter: 16.27 mm; Thickness: 1.55 mm
